note: What the trigger does — multi-valued. A select-fire rifle carries `semi` and `automatic`, and often `burst`. Recorded as a technical fact only; SPEC.md §14 forbids any content about converting an arm between these.

terms.label: Single shot
terms.description: One round, then a manual reload.

terms.label: Semi-automatic
terms.description: One shot per trigger pull, self-reloading.

terms.label: Burst
terms.description: A fixed count per trigger pull, usually two or three.

terms.label: Fully automatic
terms.description: Fires while the trigger is held and ammunition remains.
